nodes.label: Capture Panel
nodes.rationale: Headless browser interception allows bypassing local encryption for complex auth flows.

nodes.label: Encrypt Password Utility
nodes.rationale: Uses crypto-js for client-side encryption of sensitive credentials before proxying.

nodes.label: Build Backend URL Utility
nodes.rationale: Normalizes URLs to ensure consistent origin and path structure for proxying.

nodes.label: useRunner Hook
nodes.rationale: Client-side stress runner capping concurrency at 20 to balance load and browser performance.

nodes.label: Capture Login API
nodes.rationale: Puppeteer-based interception to reuse existing frontend encryption logic, avoiding local re-implementation.

nodes.label: Request Proxy API
nodes.rationale: Server-side proxy to bypass CORS restrictions when hitting upstream admin APIs.

nodes.label: Request OTP API
nodes.rationale: Rate-limited OTP request flow to prevent brute-force and spamming.
